claim: Manipulation A replicates the human_enhancers_ensembl mechanism 'exactly: 94.3% of positive rows sit on a coordinate of multiplicity 2' (docstring lines 13-15); TIER1_FINDINGS.md:219 labels the arm '94.3 % of positives duplicated'.

suggested_fix: Set RATE = 0.8913 (or solve r = t/(2-t) for target t), and correct the docstring and the TIER1_FINDINGS.md:219 row label to state the duplication rate and the resulting multiplicity-2 share separately.
